model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for several variants of a language model, including a baseline "Vanilla" model and various configurations of "StrmLLM" and "SepLLM" models with different parameters. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale, with tick marks every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis represents the loss, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks every 0.1 unit. All lines start at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a steep decline before gradually converging to lower values. The purple line (Vanilla) shows a consistent decline, ending near 2.45. The blue line (StrmLLM, n=64) starts slightly lower than Vanilla and ends near 2.6. The orange line (SepLLM, n=64) starts near 3.3 and ends near 2.5. The green line (SepLLM, n=64, H) starts at approximately 3.3 and ends near 2.5, slightly below the orange line. The red line (SepLLM, n=64, H/T) follows a similar trend to the green line but ends slightly lower, near 2.48. The dark blue line (SepLLM, n=128) starts at about 3.3 and ends near 2.5, closely following the green and red lines. All lines are solid and smooth, with no markers, and show a consistent decreasing trend throughout the iterations.
